explanation: Transform each exchange rate to its negative base-10 logarithm. Bellman–Ford relaxation then detects a reachable negative-weight cycle, which corresponds to a product of rates greater than one.
timeComplexity: O(n³) for the dense n×n rate matrix
spaceComplexity: O(n) auxiliary; the input matrix is transformed
